name: Inkpaw
tagline: Find contest opportunities with a confirmed profile and traceable sources.
description: Anna-native candidate build. Describe your interests, review and confirm an editable profile, then explicitly start a bounded public-source search using your Anna quota. Each result links to source evidence and exposes missing or conflicting facts. Source coverage is limited; fewer or zero results are possible. Confirmed profiles and manual bookmarks stay in your own app storage. No local Agent, third-party credentials, resumes or old Inkpaw account are required. Real Anna end-to-end validation and publication are pending.
